## Location
The Notre Dame Human Neuroimaging Center (ND-HNC) is located on the lower level of [501 N. Hill St., South Bend, IN 46617](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Rz3ATi5nA5a2hkPdA). We share the building with the [Veldman Family Psychology Clinic](https://veldmanclinic.nd.edu/) and the [William J. Shaw Center for Children and Families](https://shaw.nd.edu/).

## Parking
Parking is available for free on the north side of the building (access from Cedar St).

![](../media/pages/vfpc_parking.jpg)

## Entry
- Enter through the building's main (north) door.
- Access to reception is restricted -- it is possible to page the receptionist by pressing the yellow "Call" button.
- Research personnel will meet you in the main reception area and escort you to the ND-HNC.

![](../media/pages/vfpc_main_reception_call.jpg){width=75%}

For access as a researcher, please reference the following SOPs:
